title: Sovereign AI Compute & Cross-Border Weight Transfer Act

documents.title: Edge Compute Mandate for Sensitive Jurisdictions
documents.text: Compliance inference processing personal or regulatory data must run fully on local edge hardware without outbound internet connectivity. No remote API calls to external cloud LLMs are permitted.

documents.title: Model Weight Export and LoRA Adapter Provenance
documents.text: Cross-border transfers of fine-tuned LoRA adapters or quantized GGUF weights require documented cryptographically signed provenance certificates identifying the training lineage.

documents.title: Quantization Accuracy Safeguards
documents.text: When quantizing compliance models to 4-bit or 8-bit precision for edge deployment, degradation on the statutory benchmark suite must not exceed 1.5% compared to FP16 reference weights.

documents.title: Continual Model Refresh Certification
documents.text: Quarterly adapter consolidation and merge operations must preserve backward accuracy on prior regimes with less than 3% catastrophic forgetting, verified via deterministic replay gates.
